metadata.title: Uniform RC-positivity of tangent bundles
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove that every rationally connected projective manifold admits a smooth uniformly RC-positive Hermitian metric on its tangent bundle, answering Yang's question and giving a characterization of rational connectedness by uniform RC-positivity. We find an example to show that RC-positivity alone does not characterize rational connectedness. We also prove that uniform RC-positivity of the tangent bundle is preserved under blow-ups along connected smooth centers on compact complex manifolds. In the non-Kähler setting, we construct such metrics on all Hopf and Kato surfaces and obtain classification results for compact complex surfaces.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 有理连通性的 RC 正性刻画
analysis.workSummary: 对有理连通紧 Kähler 流形，以高维嵌入的非常自由有理曲线构造切丛的一致 RC 正 Hermitian 度量，并由吹起结果处理曲面。Fermat 四次 K3 提供普通 RC 正而非一致 RC 正的反例。
analysis.breakthrough: 回答 Yang 的问题并给出有理连通性的微分几何刻画。
analysis.limitations: 一致 RC 正性的量词要求同一底空间方向对所有非零纤维向量为正；不能与普通 RC 正性混淆。非 Kähler 分类不覆盖所有尚未分类的 VII 类曲面。
